reader.requirement: At --std 85, for a format 2 (OCCURS ... DEPENDING ON data-name-1) entry, the compiler must refuse a data-name-1 that occupies any character position from the first position of the ODO entry through the last (maximum) position of its record, whether data-name-1 is inside the table (at any depth), after it in the same record, or in another record that implicitly redefines the same area (multiple 01s of one FD, VI.5.3.4 GR3; SAME RECORD AREA, VII.2.13.4 GR2; an explicit REDEFINES), and accept a data-name-1 positioned before the table, outside its record, or past the record's maximum length in a sibling record.
reader.edition-search: Read DependingAdmission.Of/DependingInsideTableRange (DataBinder.Odo.cs) and the OdoResolvePass report site; grep 'Edition|DialectLevel|IsActive' in DataBinder.Odo.cs and OdoResolvePass.cs: only Edition.Error/Edition.At for other OCCURS diagnostics (OccursFormatNotPrinted, DYNAMIC rules), nothing on the SR7 path. The same-record leaf-order test and the shared-area byte-window test run identically at every --std.

reader.notes: DependingInsideTableRange answers same-record placement by leaf order and shared-area placement by byte window against the record's maximum width, which matches 1985's character-position wording given its implicit-redefinition rules. No edition switch on the path. Diagnostics cite §2023:13.18.38.3 SR20 at --std 85 (presentation only).

refuter.evidence: cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR7 ('the last character position defined by the record description entry containing that OCCURS clause'). Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-05/c6: p1 sibling FD record with N PIC 99 partly overlapping T's first position -> COBOL0857 (partial overlap caught); p2/p4 01 REDEFINES record whose data-name-1 overlaps the table (group-wrapped ODO in p4) -> COBOL0857 (+COBOL0855, correct by VI.5.14 SR5 'Neither the original definition nor the redefinition can include a variable occurrence data item'); p5 data-name-1 past the record's maximum in a redefinition -> no 0857 (only 0855); p3 data-name-1 in a REDEFINES of an earlier sibling, before the table -> runs W=03ABC; p6 data-name-1 in the table's own group before the table -> runs W=2AB; p7 SD sibling record overlap -> COBOL0857. The sibling-record reading rests on VI.5.3.4 GR3 implicit redefinition (cite.py OK): the records share the character positions, so a data-name in one occupies a position within the range. No edition arm needed; none missed.
